about: Band cut-offs by prose length for BBBScorer 0.9.x (tools/build_length_bands.mjs): Original-ish below the 94th percentile of 2023 cards (mostly human) of that length, Familiar from the 98th. From 350 prose words up, one set of cut-offs taken over all cards with 150+ prose words.
source: dev experiment rows (dev/analysis/band_rows_early2023.mjs) (score); left out 62 rows with old-school level strong
note: BBBScorer 0.9.3 scores of early-2023 collections (Pygmalion Discord, Roko's Basilisk, VenusAI, Chub mega; deduplicated), cards the lists were never mined from. ChatGPT-era cards (strong old-school level) left out of the human side; one shared cut-off from 350 prose words up.
